findings.explanation: The evidence from the NVIDIA 10-K for fiscal year ended January 25, 2026 shows revenue for FY2024 (year ended Jan 28, 2024) as $60,922 million and for FY2026 (year ended Jan 25, 2026) as $215,938 million. The candidate claim states FY2024 revenue as 60,922 million USD and FY2026 revenue as 215,938 million USD, which matches the evidence exactly. However, the claim states "Year-over-year growth from FY2024 to FY2026 is 254.4%". Growth from FY2024 to FY2026 spans two years, not one year, so it is not year-over-year growth. Therefore, the growth percentage is mislabeled as year-over-year growth, making this part of the claim unsupported.
